goal: Validate the MXGA v0.5 Firefox extension on a real Firefox runtime and retain reproducible evidence

constraints.browser: Firefox with an isolated temporary profile
constraints.cleanup: Remove temporary profiles and reverse every test-only setting or X action
constraints.evidence: Every passed task must cite command output, a screenshot path, or both

tasks.task: Establish the exact v0.5 source, toolchain, Firefox runtime, existing test surface, and generated-manifest expectations
tasks.verify: Inspect Git state, package versions, Firefox binary/version, build scripts, WXT Firefox configuration, and existing Firefox claims before changing runtime code
evidence: Git baseline: d2087403ab765e46ec6f80133a81ccf7796dd763 on codex/firefox-v0.5-validation; worktree contained only this new checklist
extension/package.json and extension/package-lock.json both report 0.5.0; WXT requirement is ^0.20.27
Installed real browser: Mozilla Firefox 150.0.3 at /Applications/Firefox.app/Contents/MacOS/firefox
Firefox scripts exist for compile, seven targeted test files, production build, development runtime, and ZIP packaging
WXT source explicitly generates Firefox Manifest V3 with gecko ID x-spam-sentinel@zuoluo.tv, minimum Firefox 109.0, host patterns in optional_permissions, and required data collection set to none
No inherited extension/node_modules or extension/.output artifacts were present; geckodriver and web-ext were not on PATH
Existing personal Firefox profiles were detected but not opened or modified; runtime validation is constrained to an isolated temporary profile

tasks.task: Compile, test, build, package, and lint the production Firefox artifact
tasks.verify: Extension compile/tests/build/zip pass; generated manifest contains the intended Firefox MV3 ID, minimum version, permissions, data-collection declaration, and no unsupported Chrome-only permission shape

tasks.task: Install the exact unpacked artifact into an isolated real Firefox profile and exercise background, popup, options, and local storage
tasks.verify: Firefox accepts the temporary add-on; popup and options render and interact; persisted settings survive reload; runtime and browser consoles contain no new MXGA errors; screenshots are captured

tasks.task: Validate content-script detection, badge/bubble interaction, local hide, undo, and processed-record recovery on an X page
tasks.verify: A deterministic or real X surface produces the expected v0.5 states in Firefox, including the repaired profile-header hide path, with before/after screenshots and no extension runtime error

tasks.task: Validate Firefox-specific optional permission and action-mode behavior
tasks.verify: X/GitHub permissions are absent after install, requested only at the documented interaction, denial falls back safely, and any explicitly authorized native X action is capped and reversed

tasks.task: Validate popup/options desktop and compact layouts, dark mode, keyboard reachability, and accessible names in Firefox
tasks.verify: Desktop and compact Firefox screenshots show no clipping or drift; focus order and accessible labels are directly checked; console remains clean

tasks.task: Attempt to falsify every prior Firefox pass and publish a concise compatibility report
tasks.verify: Re-run critical checks from the committed source, inspect all evidence files and hashes, confirm clean secret/diff review, and list any user-only or store-signing gaps
